sectors.narrative_en: China Banks sits at cycle position 94/100 (Overheated). Today's driver setup is in its low third. Months with a high driver setup were historically roughly neutral on the 6-month odds (forward-6m positive 76% of the time vs 54% base, n_months=21, n_eff≈5.2; the band includes the base rate). Today is outside that cohort. Composite from 2019-01-31 (all 4 legs live). Bullish legs: breadth (contrarian). Headwinds: washout / mean-reversion, input-cost (PPI), credit cycle.
sectors.narrative_zh: 中国银行周期位置 94/100（过热）。当前驱动配置处于历史低位区间。历史上高位配置月份，未来6个月上涨占比约 76%（基准 54%，月度样本 21，有效 n≈5.2），整体大致中性（区间包含基准）。今日不在此区间。（复合指标自 2019-01-31 起，全部 4 项因子齐备）
sectors.caveat_en: Conditional, display-only context — not a forecast or a buy signal. Phase 0 found no China driver clears a strict significance bar on monthly sector returns; this summarizes the sign-stable lead cluster honestly. The composite is a fixed constituent set, defined only from the month all legs are live (see composition), and its interval is a date-blocked bootstrap on overlapping windows — so the cohort is short but the number is one feature.
sectors.caveat_zh: 仅为条件化展示，非预测或买卖信号。Phase 0 检验显示无单一驱动能通过严格显著性门槛，此处仅诚实汇总符号稳定的领先因子组合。复合指标为固定因子集合，仅在全部因子齐备后定义，置信区间采用按日期分块的自助法（考虑窗口重叠），样本较短但口径一致。
